name: Random-init Pareto front seed 11
short_description: Per-cell DSI / PD-rate / robustness / 14-d morphology / 54-d electrophys for the Pareto front of t0099 NSGA-II run with random LHS initial population and RNG seed 11 (compare against t0091's warm-start Pareto).
model_description: DSGC compartmental model with t0092-patched procedural morphology + 54-d electrophys vector, evaluated by 16-direction x 5-seed NSGA-II starting from a Latin Hypercube Sample of the 68-d parameter space.
prediction_schema: Each line is a JSON object with fields: cell_id (int), task_seed (int), dsi_vector_sum (float), pd_rate_hz (float), robustness (float in [0, 1]), morphology_vector_14d (list[float]), electrophys_vector_54d (list[float]), nearest_anchor_index (int), nearest_anchor_name (str: bedb_like / symmetric / pd_asymmetric / nd_asymmetric / alt_topology), nearest_anchor_distance_normalised (float), verdict_biological (str: plausible / stretched / exotic / no_data).

files.description: Per-Pareto-cell record for the random-init NSGA-II run with task seed 11.
